La tolleranza al rischio è quanta oscill: Risk tolerance is how much swing and temporary loss you can bear, and can afford to bear. It also depends on your time horizon: with more years ahead you can ride out the drops without having to sell at the wrong moment; if you need the money soon, there is no time to recover.
L'indice di Sharpe dice quanto rendiment: The Sharpe ratio tells you how much return you got for each unit of risk (volatility): for the same return, whoever swung less wins. Beta compares a stock with its market: above 1 it amplifies the market's moves, both up and down.
Il premio per il rischio è il rendimento: The risk premium is the extra return expected from a risky investment compared with one considered almost risk-free, such as a short-term government bond of a solid country, which is also among the least volatile investments.
Mercato orso (bear market): un calo prol: Bear market: a prolonged decline, usually of at least 20% from the highs. Liquidity of an investment: how easily it can be sold without pushing the price down. Wide swings also slow compound growth: for the same average return, whoever swings less grows more.
Durante un calo profondo molti vendono p: During a deep drop many sell out of fear and miss the recovery: that is why the return "on paper" is not what everyone actually gets. Paper trading, meaning simulated trades with no real money, is a way to test yourself first.
Casi difficili: stop limit, gap e scoper: Hard cases: stop limit, gaps and short selling
Lo stop limit è uno stop che, quando si: A stop limit is a stop that, once triggered, becomes a limit order instead of a market order. It protects you from the worst price, but if the market falls suddenly past the limit the order finds no buyers and you are left holding the stock.
Gap: a volte un titolo apre molto lontan: Gap: sometimes a stock opens far from the previous close, because of news that arrived while markets were shut. An ordinary stop still triggers and sells at the first available price, even well below the threshold. If the price never touches the threshold, the stop stays idle and the stock is still yours.
Vendere allo scoperto (short): vendere u: Short selling: selling a borrowed stock hoping to buy it back at a lower price. If the price rises instead, the loss grows.
Su un titolo che scambia pochi pezzi al: On a stock that trades few shares a day, a large order moves the price by itself: the prudent approach is to split it into several limit orders spread over time.
Un ordine è «eseguito» quando la comprav: An order is "filled" when the trade has actually happened. Before confirming, always reread the summary: symbol, quantity, side (buy or sell), order type and estimated cost.
L'asset allocation è la divisione del po: Asset allocation is the split of a portfolio among asset classes: stocks, bonds, cash. Geographic diversification adds different countries and economic areas.
Sovrapposizione: un ETF azionario global: Overlap: a global equity ETF, a Nasdaq ETF and a few US technology stocks look like three different things, but they hold largely the same names. The true weight of a sector shows only when you add up what is inside each part.
Titoli dello stesso settore reagiscono i: Stocks in the same sector react in similar ways to the same events: three banks and an insurer are almost a single bet. And buying more shares of the same company does not diversify at all.
La correlazione va da −1 a +1. Se è nega: Correlation runs from −1 to +1. If it is negative, when one rises the other tends to fall, though not by the same amount. That is why a weakly correlated asset can lower the volatility of the whole even if it swings a lot on its own: its moves partly offset those of the others.
Nelle crisi globali, però, le correlazio: In global crises, however, correlations rise: in a panic almost everything falls together. Diversification removes most specific risk, not market risk.
L'inflazione riduce il potere d'acquisto: Inflation reduces the purchasing power of idle money: the figure stays the same, but it buys less. The real return is the nominal return minus inflation; the net real return also takes away costs and taxes.
Il TER è il costo annuo di gestione di u: The TER is the yearly management cost of a fund or ETF, as a percentage, taken from the fund's assets. It applies every year to the whole capital, and also removes the gains that money would have produced later: that is why a cost that looks small weighs so much over the long run.
«Zero commissioni» non vuol dire gratis:: "Zero commissions" does not mean free: the spread, currency conversion costs and other implicit costs remain. And fixed commissions weigh more on small amounts: many trades with little capital are expensive in percentage terms.
Con un piano di accumulo la cifra è fiss: With a savings plan the amount is fixed: when prices fall it buys more units, when they rise it buys fewer. Those who start early have an edge that later deposits struggle to close: the first money stays invested for more years and compound interest works for longer.
Un costo è certo e si ripete ogni anno;: A cost is certain and repeats every year; a good past result is not guaranteed for the future. That is why, when comparing two similar funds, cost is the most reliable figure.
Bias di conferma: cercare solo le inform: Confirmation bias: looking only for information that agrees with what we already think. Escalation of commitment: continuing to buy a falling stock only because we have already put so much into it.
Effetto disposizione: vendere subito i t: Disposition effect: selling winners quickly and holding losers for a long time. A useful question: "If I had that sum in cash today, would I buy it?" The price paid should not drive the choice.
Autoattribuzione: i successi sono merito: Self-attribution: successes are my merit, failures are bad luck. It is a relative of overconfidence. Recency bias: giving too much weight to the latest events, such as believing that after three months of gains the market can no longer fall.
Fallacia del giocatore: pensare che dopo: Gambler's fallacy: thinking that after a run of gains "now it must fall". A run does not make the opposite outcome more likely. Survivorship bias: looking only at the funds still alive makes results look better than they were on average.
Effetto cornice (framing): «nel 90% dei: Framing effect: "it does not lose 90% of the time" and "it loses 10% of the time" say the same thing, but the first is more appealing. And checking the portfolio too often shows more temporary losses and raises the temptation to act on impulse.
Investire non è scommettere: un investim: Investing is not betting: a diversified investment has a positive expected return over time, a bet usually a negative one. After a run of winning trades the prudent rule is the same as before: follow the plan, with the same risk management.
Position sizing: decidere quanto capital: Position sizing: deciding how much capital to put into each trade. Risking 1% means that, if the stop triggers, you lose at most 1% of total capital. Whoever risks 10% per trade is fragile: a losing streak, normal even by pure chance, leads to a collapse that is hard to climb back from.
L'aspettativa (expectancy) di una strate: The expectancy of a strategy is the average result per trade: it takes into account how often you win and how much you win or lose each time. You can win often and still lose money, if the losses are bigger than the wins.
Lo stop non è una garanzia sul prezzo: d: A stop is not a guarantee on price: after an opening gap it becomes a market order and is filled at the first available price, even below the threshold. The loss can exceed the planned risk.
Con la leva usi denaro preso in prestito: With leverage you use borrowed money, and every move of the underlying is multiplied on your capital: an ordinary move of a volatile asset can be enough to wipe it out. The maintenance margin is the minimum share of your own capital that must stay in the account; below that threshold comes the margin call.
Rialzi e ribassi della stessa ampiezza n: Gains and losses of the same size do not cancel out: after a sharp drop you need an even larger percentage gain to break even. That is why limiting large losses matters more than chasing large gains.
Il piano scritto decide a mente fredda i: A written plan decides entry, exit and maximum loss with a cool head, before entering the trade. It also applies to a position that has grown too large: you set a maximum weight and sell the excess gradually, considering costs and taxes. And you invest only money you will not need soon.
Il vocabolario della borsa: The vocabulary of the stock market
IPO: la prima offerta al pubblico delle: IPO: the first public offering of the shares of a company going public. Ordinary shares give the right to vote at shareholder meetings, in proportion to how many you hold. If the company goes bankrupt, shareholders are repaid last.
Un indice azionario è un paniere di tito: A stock index is a basket of securities that represents the trend of a market. "Large caps" are companies with a very high market capitalization.
Growth: azioni di aziende che puntano a: Growth: stocks of companies aiming to grow fast, often by reinvesting profits. Value: stocks that look cheap relative to earnings or book value.
Frazionamento (split) 2 a 1: ogni azione: A 2-for-1 stock split: each share becomes two, at half the price. The total value does not change. That is why a 5 share is not "cheaper" than a 500 one: price alone cannot tell you, you need earnings and the number of shares.
Il prezzo riflette le attese sull'aziend: Price reflects expectations about the company. A company can announce record earnings and still fall, if the market expected even more.
Il bilancio ha tre prospetti principali:: Financial statements have three main parts: the income statement (revenue, costs, profit), the balance sheet (what the company owns and what it owes) and the cash flow statement (how cash comes in and goes out: operations, investments, financing).
Ricavi o fatturato: il denaro incassato: Revenue or sales: the money taken in from selling, before costs. Operating margin: the share of revenue left after operating costs. Earnings per share (EPS): net profit divided by the number of shares. The P/E tells how many times the price contains one year's earnings per share.
Patrimonio netto: attività meno passivit: Shareholders' equity: assets minus liabilities, meaning the company's own funds. The debt-to-equity ratio tells how much the company is financed with debt compared with its own funds: the higher it is, the more fragile the company.
Utili e cassa non sono la stessa cosa. S: Profit and cash are not the same thing. If profits grow but operating cash flow stays negative, or if receivables grow much faster than revenue, the company is selling on credit without collecting: accounting profits are not turning into real cash.
Un P/E molto più alto del settore dice c: A P/E far above the sector says the market expects much more growth; with high debt, the company is also more fragile. Official statements are found in the investor section of the company's website and in filings with the authorities.
Chi paga e chi no: Who pays and who does not
Il dividendo non è garantito: l'azienda: A dividend is not guaranteed: the company can cut or suspend it. From the ex-dividend date, whoever buys the share is no longer entitled to the dividend already announced.
Pagano dividendi stabili soprattutto le: Stable dividends are paid mostly by mature companies with predictable cash flows. A growing company may prefer not to pay them: reinvesting profits in the business can create more value.
Il rendimento totale di un'azione è la v: The total return of a stock is the price change plus dividends. A low dividend that grows along with earnings can, over the years, overtake a high but flat one.
Se un'azienda distribuisce quasi tutti g: If a company pays out almost all its profits and profits are falling, the payout leaves no cushion: the dividend risks being cut. A dividend yield far above the sector is often the sign of a price that collapsed because of problems.
Gestione passiva: replicare un indice in: Passive management: tracking an index instead of trying to beat it. An S&P 500 ETF, for example, invests in the roughly 500 large companies of the US index. If those stocks fall, the ETF falls too: it can lose value just like what it holds.
Ponderazione per capitalizzazione: nell': Capitalization weighting: in the index the largest companies weigh more. Accumulating: the ETF reinvests dividends and coupons by itself. Distributing: it pays them periodically into your account.
La sigla UCITS dice che il fondo rispett: The UCITS label says the fund follows the European protection rules for funds sold to the public. An ETF is bought and sold during market hours, at the market price: between the price at which you buy and the one at which you sell there is a bid-ask spread.
Un ETF a leva 3x cerca di ottenere tre v: A 3x leveraged ETF tries to deliver three times the daily return of the index. The leverage is reset every day: if the market swings, compounding erodes the value, and whoever holds it for long can get far less than three times the index.
Nella replica sintetica il contratto con: In synthetic replication the contract with the bank is called a swap: the risk that remains is that the counterparty fails to honour it. In physical "sampling" replication the fund buys only a representative selection of the index's securities.
Il KID è il documento con le informazion: The KID is the key information document: a few pages on risks, costs and scenarios, to read before buying. The domicile is the country where the fund is registered: it matters for rules and taxation.
NAV: il valore dei titoli che l'ETF cont: NAV: the value of the securities the ETF holds. The market price can drift from it for a while, because of supply and demand; market makers usually narrow the gap.
Un ETF «world» contiene azioni di molti: A "world" ETF holds stocks from many developed countries, sometimes emerging ones too: if one of its 1,600 companies fails, the effect is minimal. A sector ETF is less diversified and more exposed to the risk of a single sector.
Tra ETF che replicano lo stesso indice c: Among ETFs tracking the same index with similar deviations, over the long run the most efficient is the one with the lowest TER.
Rischio di credito: il rischio che l'emi: Credit risk: the risk that the issuer fails to pay coupons or principal. The rating is an agency's opinion on the issuer's ability to repay. At maturity the issuer repays the face value, if it is solvent.
Le obbligazioni ad alto rendimento (high: High-yield bonds pay more because their issuers have a higher risk of default. High-quality bonds yield less, but in a portfolio they serve to reduce overall volatility and provide stability.
Rendimento e prezzo si muovono in direzi: Yield and price move in opposite directions. A bond trading well below face value has a yield to maturity higher than its coupon: at redemption you receive the full face value, having paid less for it.
Con i titoli di Stato presti allo Stato:: With government bonds you lend to the state: you receive the coupons and repayment at maturity. When market rates rise, the bond ETF with the longest duration loses the most.
Proof-of-work: i miner validano i blocch: Proof-of-work: miners validate blocks using computing power (mining). Proof-of-stake: blocks are confirmed by those who lock up coins as collateral. Network fees (gas fees) are the cost paid to the network to process a transaction or run a smart contract.
Capitalizzazione di una cripto: prezzo p: Market cap of a crypto: price times the number of units in circulation. Low-cap ones are illiquid and easy to manipulate, for example with a pump and dump.
I mercati delle cripto sono aperti 24 or: Crypto markets are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. If an unregulated exchange fails, the funds left there can be lost: there are often no guarantees like those on bank deposits.
In Europa il regolamento MiCA fissa rego: In Europe the MiCA regulation sets rules for crypto-asset markets and for those who provide services on them. The value of many cryptos depends on supply, demand and the perceived usefulness of the network: there are no corporate profits behind them.
Wallet non custodial: solo tu controlli: Non-custodial wallet: only you control the private keys. Hardware wallet: a physical device that keeps the keys offline. The public address is the code you share to receive crypto: it is visible to everyone and does not allow spending.
Una transazione è irreversibile: se l'in: A transaction is irreversible: if the address is wrong, the funds are generally not recovered. Before confirming, check the exact address and the correct network, perhaps with a small test transfer.
Phishing: un sito che imita un exchange: Phishing: a site imitating an exchange can be spotted by a web address slightly different from the official one. Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a second check beyond the password.
Token sconosciuti comparsi nel wallet (a: Unknown tokens that appear in your wallet (suspicious airdrops) are often bait to make you interact with malicious contracts. And "approving" a contract with unlimited access means it will be able to move all those tokens without asking you again.
Tenere per anni molte cripto su un excha: Keeping a lot of crypto on an exchange for years means depending on its solvency and its security. The seed phrase is written on paper or metal, offline, in a protected place.
Rendimenti che non tornano: Returns that do not add up
Una stablecoin non è un conto in banca:: A stablecoin is not a bank account: it has no deposit guarantee and depends on the issuer and its reserves. Serious ones publish independent audits of their reserves. If it trades below 1 dollar for days, the market doubts redemption: it can lose its peg entirely, as happened to a well-known algorithmic stablecoin in May 2022.
Staking: bloccare cripto per contribuire: Staking: locking up crypto to help secure a network in exchange for rewards. Smart contract risk: a bug in the code can let someone steal or freeze the funds.
Prestare stablecoin a una piattaforma ce: Lending stablecoins to a centralized platform exposes you to the risk that it fails or freezes withdrawals, as happened in 2022. A 1,000% yearly yield, or a "guaranteed 20% a month", does not come from any real activity: it is unsustainable, or it is a scam.
Lo schema Ponzi esiste anche nelle cript: The Ponzi scheme exists in crypto too: the "returns" of earlier investors are paid with the money of new ones. Rug pull signals: anonymous team, copied project document (whitepaper), unlocked liquidity that the creators can withdraw at any moment.
Le classi principali sono azioni, obblig: The main classes are stocks, bonds, cash and alternative investments: assets other than the first three, such as commodities, real estate or crypto. Over the long run stocks have historically had the highest return and volatility.
Le materie prime come l'oro possono dive: Commodities such as gold can diversify, but they produce no cash flows. Crypto, according to many prudent guides, deserves at most a small share: it is very volatile and speculative.
La liquidità serve ad avere denaro dispo: Cash serves to have money available for expenses and opportunities, and it reduces volatility. But inflation wears it down: every year it buys fewer goods. Currency risk: exchange rate moves can reduce the euro value of foreign investments.
Correlazione bassa: due investimenti ten: Low correlation: two investments tend to move independently. Combining different classes reduces risk because they react differently to events. It does not remove it: in 2022 stocks and bonds fell together, because correlations change.
Il profilo di rischio dipende da obietti: Your risk profile depends on goals, horizon, financial situation and tolerance for losses. "Stocks only, since they return more in the long run" forgets that before the long run come deep drops, and not everyone can sit through them without selling.
Allocazione strategica: la ripartizione: Strategic allocation: the long-term split, consistent with goals and risk. That is where you start: goals, horizon and how much you can afford to lose. "80/20" means 80% in riskier assets, such as stocks, and 20% in more stable ones.
Deriva: i pesi cambiano da soli, perché: Drift: the weights change by themselves, because the classes return differently. You can rebalance by calendar or by threshold, that is only when a weight moves away by a set number of points: inside the threshold you do nothing, saving trades and costs.
Core-satellite: un nucleo diversificato: Core-satellite: a diversified, stable core plus small, riskier "satellite" holdings. A balanced or multi-asset ETF puts several asset classes into a single instrument.
Quando l'obiettivo si avvicina, per esem: As the goal gets closer, for example buying a home in two years, the risky share is usually reduced little by little. Someone young with a long horizon can tolerate more stocks, because there is more time to recover from drops.
Un titolo di giornale allarmante non è u: An alarming newspaper headline is not a good reason to change the strategic allocation. A savings plan helps those starting out: it spreads purchases over time and reduces the weight of the entry moment.
A Wall Street si dice che i prezzi respi: On Wall Street they say prices breathe with the economy: rates, inflation, growth and currencies move everything else.
Il primo Superiore interroga sulla macro: The first Elder quizzes you on macroeconomics: what central banks do, how bonds, stocks and currencies react, and why expectations matter more than news.
PIL: il valore dei beni e servizi finali: GDP: the value of the final goods and services produced in a country over a period. Unemployment rate: the percentage of the labour force looking for work and not finding it. In a recession the economy shrinks; defensive sectors, such as utilities and consumer staples, suffer less.
Inflazione: l'aumento generale dei prezz: Inflation: the general rise in prices. "Core" inflation leaves out the most unstable items, such as energy and fresh food. Stagflation: high inflation together with low or negative growth.
Per frenare l'inflazione una banca centr: To curb inflation a central bank raises interest rates; to support growth it lowers them. The ECB's target is 2% inflation over the medium term. With quantitative easing (QE) the central bank buys securities on a massive scale to lower long-term rates.
Le banche centrali guardano anche le asp: Central banks also watch expectations: if everyone expects higher prices, wages and price lists rise and inflation feeds itself. Fiscal policy belongs to governments instead: it is expansionary when it raises public spending or cuts taxes to support demand.
Se l'inflazione supera il tasso di un co: If inflation exceeds the rate on a savings account, the real return is negative: the balance grows, but it buys less.
Quando i tassi salgono, le obbligazioni: When rates rise, existing bonds fall in price, the more so the higher their duration. With a fixed-rate bond and rising inflation the damage is double: the price falls and the fixed coupons buy fewer goods.
Curva dei rendimenti: i tassi per ogni s: Yield curve: the rates for each maturity. It is inverted when short rates exceed long ones: usually the market expects a slowdown. Putting everything into short-term bills because they yield more overlooks reinvestment risk: if rates fall, at maturity you reinvest at lower yields.
Tassi alti pesano sulle azioni di cresci: High rates weigh on growth stocks, because much of their value lies in profits far in the future, which get discounted more. They also weigh on companies heavily indebted at floating rates: interest rises and cuts profits. Quarterly earnings are the results listed companies publish every three months.
Lo spread dei titoli di Stato si allarga: The government bond spread widens when investors doubt a country's public finances: the state must pay higher interest to fund itself. In phases of strong uncertainty and fear many turn to gold as a safe haven.
Valute: un rialzo dei tassi più forte de: Currencies: a rate hike stronger than expected tends to strengthen the currency, because it makes investments in that currency more attractive. If you invest in dollars and the dollar weakens, your return in euros gets worse. A currency-hedged ETF uses currency contracts to reduce this effect.
Un euro forte pesa su un'azienda europea: A strong euro weighs on a European company that sells in the United States: every dollar it takes in is worth fewer euros and its products cost Americans more.
I prezzi incorporano le attese: se un ri: Prices already include expectations: if a rate hike had been expected for months, the market may move little or even rise. What counts is the surprise. In stagflation a 60/40 portfolio can lose on both sides: rates and inflation hit bonds, weak growth hits profits and therefore stocks.
A Wall Street si usano due lenti. L'anal: On Wall Street two lenses are used. Fundamental analysis looks at the company: financial statements, growth, debt, sector. Technical analysis looks at the market: prices and volumes, to spot trends.
Il secondo Superiore interroga su entram: The second Elder quizzes you on both, and above all on their limits: neither predicts the future, and past returns do not guarantee future ones, because economic, company and market conditions change.
Capitalizzazione di mercato: prezzo dell: Market capitalization: share price times the number of shares outstanding. P/E (price/earnings): a value far above the sector says the market expects a lot of growth, or that the stock is expensive. Multiples are compared among similar companies: a bank and a software company have different growth, risk and accounts.
P/BV (prezzo/valore di libro): quanto il: P/BV (price to book value): how much the market pays for the company compared with the equity written in its accounts. PEG: the P/E divided by expected earnings growth; it helps judge how expensive a stock is given how much its earnings should grow.
EBITDA: il margine prima di interessi, t: EBITDA: the margin before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization. Read it with caution, because it ignores debt and necessary investments. Free cash flow: the cash generated by the business that is left after the investments needed to maintain it.
Il rapporto tra debiti e patrimonio nett: The debt-to-equity ratio must be compared with the sector: for a utility more debt is normal than for software. If operating profit only just exceeds the interest on debt, a small drop in revenue is enough to put the company in trouble, even if it is profitable today.
Qualità degli utili: ricavi in crescita: Earnings quality: growing revenue with falling profits and rising debt calls for a look at margins, costs and debt sustainability. Receivables growing much faster than sales, with operating cash falling, point to sales with deferred payments or that are hard to collect.
Un margine operativo stabilmente più alt: An operating margin steadily higher than competitors' can indicate a competitive advantage: a strong brand, low costs or pricing power.
La lente tecnica e le sue trappole: The technical lens and its traps
Volume: il numero di azioni scambiate in: Volume: the number of shares traded over a period. Uptrend: progressively higher highs and lows. Support: a price level where declines stopped in the past. Resistance: a level where rallies stopped.
Media mobile a 50 giorni: la media dei p: 50-day moving average: the average of the closing prices of the last 50 days, updated daily. In a sideways market moving averages give false signals: repeated crossovers with no real trend, which make you enter and exit several times at a loss.
RSI: un indicatore della forza dei movim: RSI: an indicator of the strength of recent moves. Above 70 it is often read as overbought, meaning a rise that may be excessive in the short term. Divergence: the price makes a new high but the RSI does not; the push behind the rise is weakening.
Il superamento di una resistenza con vol: A break above resistance on very low volume should be read with caution: without volume the breakout is weak and may prove false. And a stock above its 200-day moving average for years gives no certainty that it will keep rising.
Backtest: provare una strategia sui dati: Backtest: trying a strategy on past data. The main doubt is overfitting, meaning a strategy "fitted" to the past, and whether realistic costs are included. If 200 parameter combinations are tried, the best one is probably inflated by chance: it must be checked on data never used to choose it.
Un fondo che batte l'indice con beta 1,6: A fund that beats the index with a beta of 1.6 in an always-rising market may owe most of its result to higher market risk, not to the manager's skill.
In ogni Biblioteca c'è uno scaffale che: In every Library there is a shelf that belongs to no Whale: the shelf of rules. Whoever has read it can spot a speculator from afar.
Gli speculatori lungo i Percorsi e i Sup: The speculators along the Trails and the Elders of Wall Street quiz you on scams, protections and market abuse. Everything they ask is here.
Campanelli d'allarme: rendimenti alti e: Warning signs: high and "guaranteed" returns, pressure to decide fast, unauthorized operators, requests for passwords or keys. A "guaranteed 20% a month" is a sign of a scam, not an opportunity. And if you do not understand an offer, that is a good reason to stop and look deeper.
Schema Ponzi: una truffa che paga i vecc: Ponzi scheme: a scam that pays earlier investors with the money of new ones. Payments are punctual as long as new money comes in; then those who want to withdraw get excuses and requests for "release fees". If it rewards whoever brings in new members it is a pyramid scheme.
Pump and dump: gonfiare artificialmente: Pump and dump: artificially inflating the price of a thinly traded stock, often with coordinated social media messages, and then selling to the new buyers. Behind someone recommending an unknown stock "with certain gains" there may be this, or a conflict of interest. You do not buy, and you can report it to the authority.
Phishing: email, SMS o siti clone che im: Phishing: emails, text messages or clone sites imitating your bank or broker. Do not use the link you received: type the official address yourself, or call the official number you found yourself. No serious intermediary asks you to install remote control software: whoever gets it can trade in your place and empty the account.
Prima di affidare denaro a qualcuno si v: Before entrusting money to anyone, check that they are authorized and listed in the registers of the supervisory authorities. In Italy the supervisor is Consob, which publishes warnings about unauthorized operators. A "licence number" from a faraway country that cannot be found in official registers is an alarm: you do not invest.
MiFID II è la direttiva europea che prot: MiFID II is the European directive that protects investors. Whoever recommends a product to you must assess its suitability: goals, experience, financial situation. If you buy a complex product on your own, the appropriateness test checks that you have enough knowledge and experience to understand its risks.
Best execution: l'intermediario deve ese: Best execution: the intermediary must execute orders on the best terms for you (price, costs, speed). Asset segregation: clients' securities are kept separate from the intermediary's own assets; if it fails, they are not used to pay its debts.
KID: poche pagine standard con rischi, c: KID: a few standard pages with a product's risks, costs and scenarios, to read before buying. A "guaranteed capital" claim must be read there: often the guarantee is conditional, valid only at maturity and only if the issuer is solvent; before that, the value can fall.
KYC (Know Your Customer): le procedure c: KYC (Know Your Customer): the procedures by which an intermediary identifies the client. Whoever invests from Italy through a foreign broker must, in general, report the account and the income in their own tax return.
Abusi di mercato, tutti vietati. Insider: Market abuse, all forbidden. Insider trading: trading on material information not yet public. Market manipulation: spreading false news or making sham trades to distort a price. Front running: an intermediary trading for itself ahead of a client's order, exploiting its effect.
Cripto: le autorità europee (ESMA) avver: Crypto: the European authorities (ESMA) warn that it is very risky and that investors can lose all the money invested. The MiCA regulation sets rules for those who issue crypto-assets or offer services on them in the European Union.
Ponzi, pump and dump e phishing: Ponzi, pump and dump and phishing
Schema Ponzi: una truffa che paga i vecc: Ponzi scheme: a scam that pays earlier investors with the money of new ones. It holds up as long as new money comes in, then it collapses.
Pump and dump: qualcuno gonfia il prezzo: Pump and dump: someone inflates the price of a thinly traded stock with enthusiastic messages, then sells to those who arrived later. Behind a "sure" tip there may be this, or a conflict of interest.
Phishing: messaggi che imitano la banca: Phishing: messages imitating your bank or broker to make you enter your password. Do not use the link you received: type the official address yourself.
